units.source_text: 我们是这样的相爱，而且我预知了两人的恋情，

en.t: We loved each other so deeply, and I had foreseen the love between the two of us,

units.source_text: 为什么竟未能领悟到你和绫子结婚，或者你已经死了呢？

en.t: so why was I still unable to realize that you had married Ayako, or that you were already dead?

units.source_text: 为什么你的灵魂不告诉我你的死讯呢？

en.t: Why did your soul not tell me the news of your death?
